post_clip.description: A woman in a red top and denim shorts (center-left) is seen actively concealing a large dark item—likely merchandise—under her arm and against her torso while standing near a counter/shelf area. She then turns and moves toward the exit path with the item hidden, exhibiting classic shoplifting behavior: concealment followed by attempted egress. Other patrons appear unaware, and no staff intervention is visible. The timing and motion across frames (especially 00:08–00:12) show deliberate concealment and movement away from display areas.

A woman in a white top and hat (visible in frames 0–4) appears to conceal an item into her blue bag while near shelves; she then walks away quickly toward the back of the store. In frame 5, she bends sharply while moving past another person, possibly adjusting or hiding the item. By frames 6–12, she and others have moved deeper into the store, but the initial behavior—rapid concealment followed by swift departure from the shelf area—is consistent with shoplifting.
